verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own overview docs list a Chrome integration titled "Debug live web applications", so the capability is first-party and directly applicable. However, the evidence is only that heading plus a generic "build, debug, and ship" claim. Nothing describes how it attaches to a running app, inspects the DOM, console or network, or reproduces bugs, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: detailed docs of the Chrome debugging workflow (connecting to a live app, console/network/DOM inspection, interaction), supported browsers and limitations, independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant

citations.quote: Build, debug, and ship from your terminal, IDE, Slack, web, and more.
